headline: Google Home Speakers found downloading excessive background data
summary: Some Google Home Speakers have been downloading huge amounts of data in the background, a bug possibly tied to a failed firmware update; a Wired writer found other smart home devices showing the same issue.

claims.statement: Some Google Home Speakers have been downloading very large amounts of data in the background.

sources.quote: hundreds of gigabytes of data are being continuously downloaded to their device in the background
had been burning through more data than all the rest of my devices combined

claims.statement: The issue may be caused by a failed or incorrect firmware update.

sources.quote: may be caused by the speakers failing to correctly download and install a firmware update

claims.statement: Other smart home devices have shown the same data-usage problem.

sources.quote: I found other smart home devices that had the same problem.
